image_description: A low-resolution, vintage-style photograph showing the lower torso and legs of a toddler standing in front of a mirror. The child is wearing a white cloth diaper that appears to be secured with safety pins or folded tabs, rather than modern adhesive tapes. The diaper is bulky and gathered at the legs. The background includes a wooden dresser, a red garment, and reflections in the mirror.
